# paper-search-mcp (repo wrapper — build/rebuild documentation)

Repo-side documentation wrapper for the `paper-search` MCP server. Upstream:
https://github.com/openags/paper-search-mcp (PyPI package `paper-search-mcp`, MIT).
This directory deliberately vendors NO source and NO venv. The live executable stays
over on D::

    D:/ReverseTools/mcp/paper-search-mcp/venv/Scripts/paper-search-mcp.exe

The registry SSOT entry (`paper-search` in `C:/Users/Prekzursil/.agents/agents.json`)
already points at that absolute path and is NOT changed by this wrapper.

## What is installed (verified 2026-09-19)

| fact | value |
|---|---|
| PyPI package | `paper-search-mcp` (dist: `paper_search_mcp-0.1.4.dist-info`) |
| Version | 0.1.4 — pin rebuilds to this until deliberately bumped |
| Python | 3.14.6 from `C:\Python314\python.exe` |
| venv path | `D:\ReverseTools\mcp\paper-search-mcp\venv` (created via `python -m venv`) |
| console scripts | `paper-search-mcp.exe` = server (`paper_search_mcp.server:main`); `paper-search.exe` = CLI (`paper_search_mcp.cli:main`) |
| key deps | fastmcp 3.4.2 (+ fastmcp_slim 3.4.2), httpx 0.28.1, lxml 6.1.1, feedparser 6.0.12, beautifulsoup4 4.15.0 |

## Build (first install) — must run ON the D: path, any cwd

    C:\Python314\python.exe -m venv D:\ReverseTools\mcp\paper-search-mcp\venv
    D:\ReverseTools\mcp\paper-search-mcp\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip
    D:\ReverseTools\mcp\paper-search-mcp\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install paper-search-mcp==0.1.4

## Rebuild

Rename the old venv aside FIRST (estate rule: never delete outright), then re-run the
Build block. `build.ps1 -Apply -Rebuild` in this directory does exactly this. Trash the
`venv.old-*` directory only after the new venv is verified healthy.

## Mixed-drive note (why the venv is NOT vendored into this repo)

This repo lives on C: while the artifact lives on D:. A Python venv is NOT relocatable:
`pyvenv.cfg` embeds absolute `home`/`executable` paths and every console-script `*.exe`
launcher embeds the absolute interpreter path. Copying or moving a venv — across drives
or directories — produces a broken environment that fails at launch. Therefore:

1. Never copy/move the venv into this repo; this wrapper documents it instead.
2. Never build on C: and move to D:. Build in place at the D: path above.
3. Client registrations keep the absolute `D:/...` command path (they already do:
   `.agents/agents.json`, `tools/mcp/canonical-mcp-servers.json`, `tools/mcp-manager/core/presets.py`).

# paper-search-mcp build/rebuild stub — D:-resident venv; repo-side wrapper is docs-only.
# Dry-run by default (prints the exact commands). -Apply executes them. -Rebuild renames
# the existing venv aside first (never deletes). NO registry change either way:
# .agents/agents.json keeps pointing at
# D:/ReverseTools/mcp/paper-search-mcp/venv/Scripts/paper-search-mcp.exe
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$Rebuild
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$py      = 'C:\Python314\python.exe'          # Python 3.14.6, verified 2026-09-19
$venvDir = 'D:\ReverseTools\mcp\paper-search-mcp\venv'
$pyExe   = "$venvDir\Scripts\python.exe"
$pkg     = 'paper-search-mcp==0.1.4'           # verified installed version 2026-09-19

if (-not (Test-Path $py)) { throw "Interpreter not found: $py" }
if ($Rebuild -and -not (Test-Path $venvDir)) { throw "-Rebuild set but no existing venv at $venvDir" }

$stamp  = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$steps = @()
if ($Rebuild) { $steps += "Rename-Item '$venvDir' 'venv.old-$stamp'" }
$steps += "& '$py' -m venv '$venvDir'"
$steps += "& '$pyExe' -m pip install --upgrade pip"
$steps += "& '$pyExe' -m pip install $pkg"
$steps += "Test-Path '$venvDir\Scripts\paper-search-mcp.exe'"
$steps += "& '$pyExe' -m pip show paper-search-mcp"

if (-not $Apply) {
    Write-Host 'DRY-RUN (stub). Re-run with -Apply to execute:'
    $steps
    exit 0
}
foreach ($s in $steps) { Write-Host "> $s"; Invoke-Expression $s }
steps.risk: low — stub is dry-run by default; when executed with -Apply it writes only under D:/ReverseTools/mcp/paper-search-mcp/ (venv create/rename + pip install); touches no registry, no repo config
